publicationDecision: Prepare revised editions for review before publishing.

criteria.issue: Broken sequel and audience promise
criteria.change: Shared promise: one agent claim, one visible check, one bounded conclusion. E1 ends with tool success versus completion; E2 opens on that exact problem.
criteria.evidence: Both revised scripts, title/description records and final CTA states.

criteria.issue: E1 repeats setup; consequence is abstract
criteria.change: Inspect C-17 and queued publication appear in the opening. New fictional consequence: an unreviewed change would reach users.

criteria.issue: Literal-name counterexample is neglected
criteria.change: Replay pinned ADJUDICATE expression for dangerous-tool and publish-alias. Unknown name returns ALLOW; no live bypass is claimed.

criteria.issue: Jargon and misleading authority hierarchy
criteria.change: Request, organizational grant, operator approval, protected grant and dispatcher precede specialist terms. Returned labels and their limits share the main visual field.

criteria.issue: Trust boundary lacks owner and failure behavior
criteria.change: Proposed dispatcher holds effect credential; grant is outside agent control; unavailable authorization holds. All are explicitly proposed, not live proof.

criteria.issue: Payoff is another status badge
criteria.change: Local toy inspection returns passing title/owner and missing summary for C-17. Published state remains false.
criteria.evidence: E1 scenes 06–07 and stored toy observations.

criteria.issue: Changed conditions and proof scope compressed
criteria.change: C-18 does not match the C-17 grant. Changed arguments and unavailable authorization are checked locally. Same-session bindings and unobserved shell/adapter routes stay explicit.

criteria.issue: E2 never returns to agent engineering
criteria.change: Show success response, separate venue-state fixture, required outcome, corrected report and explicit evaluator rubric.

criteria.issue: Weak first question and representation detour
criteria.change: Put both affected members and existing plans before the first choice. Remove table-versus-prose detour; allow one check and reserve booking changes.

criteria.issue: No new fact forces an update
criteria.change: Fictional venue reply removes other times in the same room/day. Travel conflict, others' plans and change authority remain unchanged.

criteria.issue: Inquiry has no stopping condition
criteria.change: Stop after the one authorized availability check. Hand confirmed facts and unresolved constraints to coordinator; no invented agreement or universal attendance rule.

criteria.issue: Graphics are dense or merely decorative
criteria.change: Replace repeated two-row plates with 19 individually authored subsection compositions: dilemma, predicate dissection, counterexample, authority map, dispatcher cutaway, probes, report, mismatch, evidence investigation, doctrine, time conflict, bounded choice, diptych, claim planes, redline, venue note, handoff and evaluation. Preserve independent exact SVG.
criteria.evidence: Section direction/composition JSON, material receipts, per-state SVG and encoded samples.

criteria.issue: Human stills act as repetitive wallpaper
criteria.change: Generate section-specific Nano Banana staging: human dilemma, affected participants and bounded handoff, intercut with material evidence scenes. Maintain cast identity; no invented agreement or live action.
criteria.evidence: 19 current Nano Banana assets and hash-bound material review.

criteria.issue: Mobile legibility and competing caption space
criteria.change: Large main text, separate caption-safe lower area, responsive companion flow, sampled 480- and 375-pixel frames, 320-pixel thumbnail review.
criteria.evidence: review/*-480.jpg, review/*-375.jpg, thumbnail-320.jpg and local companion pages.

criteria.issue: Long captions and orphan fragments
criteria.change: Use global clause segmentation over word alignment; enforce duration/line/character bounds and preserve the exact script. Test short-tail regression.
criteria.evidence: New captions, release metrics, narration-review.json and caption regression test.

criteria.issue: Final AAC peak headroom
criteria.change: Two-pass mastering with -2 dBTP target, then measure and decode the delivered AAC; encoded peak must stay at or below -1 dBTP.
criteria.evidence: Final audio measurements and release receipts.

criteria.issue: Title, thumbnail, opening and CTA mismatch
criteria.change: WHO STOPS IT? and BOOKED. STILL STUCK. match the revised openings and useful companion takeaways. These are creative hypotheses, not measured winners.
criteria.evidence: Prepared local thumbnails, title.txt, description.txt and review pages.

criteria.issue: Custom thumbnail deployment unverified
criteria.change: Verify custom-thumbnail availability, selected artwork, subtitles and revised URLs at publication. Originals remain in place per user review-first decision.

criteria.issue: Takeaways buried and pilot separation unclear
criteria.change: Prominent boundary checklist and outcome worksheet; newly authored public exercises. Controlled workshop and reserved assessments unchanged.
criteria.evidence: Companion JSON records and local review pages.

criteria.issue: Production conformance mistaken for learning proof
criteria.change: Separate automated production checks, sampled visual review, uninterrupted human listening and unfamiliar-viewer responses. Provide review prompts and leave uncollected results explicit.

criteria.issue: Episode content hardcoded in Python
criteria.change: Move all episode copy, direction, states, assets, fixtures and provider settings to JSON records. Shared workers load revision IDs through a store adapter; schema and stale-input checks protect projections.
criteria.evidence: Content, section direction, explicit compositions, asset reviews and companion JSON; record-driven regression tests.
